sources.title: KPIT Technologies Q2FY27 results: Net profit declines 29% to ₹121 crore
sources.description:
KPIT Technologies reported a nearly 29 per cent decline in consolidated net profit to Rs 121 crore in the second quarter ended September, mainly on account of pressure on the automobile market from Chinese vehicle makers slowing down deals.
The company had posted net profit of Rs 169 crore in the same period a year ago.
KPIT expects losses to come down from the third quarter onwards.
"Two of our largest clients are where you have seen a large decline. One is in Europe, one is in Japan. We do believe that both these accounts will bottom out over the next couple of quarters. Two or three quarters at the most is what we are looking at. However, for some of our existing OEMs' clients in passenger cars, trucks and off-highway, we will see growth come bit by bit," KPIT Technologies co-founder and joint managing director Sachin Tikekar said during the company's earnings call.

sources.title: PVR INOX Q2 profit up 2-fold at ₹263.1 cr on strong box office performance
sources.description:
Leading cinema exhibitor PVR INOX on Wednesday reported a two-fold increase in its consolidated net profit to Rs 263.1 crore for the September quarter, led by strong box office performance.
The company reported a net profit of Rs 105.5 crore for the July-September quarter a year ago, according to a regulatory filing.
PVR INOX revenue from operations rose 16.97 per cent to Rs 2,105.1 crore in the September quarter of FY27, the company said, its "highest-ever quarterly revenue". It posted revenue of Rs 1,799.6 crore in the corresponding period in the last fiscal.
Total expenses were Rs 1,788.2 crore in the September quarter, up 5.86 per cent.
The company recorded its highest-ever quarterly box office performance, with admissions rising 4 per cent to 4.63 crore. Its occupancy improved to 30.4 per cent from 28.7 per cent in the year-ago period. PVR Inox said this is also its "its highest-ever quarterly" figure.

sources.title: Hero MotoCorp Q2FY27 results: Net profit soars 42% to ₹1,861 crore
sources.description:
India's largest two-wheeler maker Hero MotoCorp on Wednesday reported a 42 per cent year-on-year rise in consolidated profit after tax for the second quarter of the current fiscal.
The company's consolidated profit for the quarter came in at Rs 1,861 crore, against Rs 1,308 crore in the year-ago period, according to a regulatory filing.
Revenue from operations increased to Rs 14,971 crore, up 23 per cent from Rs 12,218 crore a year ago.
"Results for the quarter and half-year include a Rs 397 crore gain from the equity consolidation of an associate company, following its capital raise via a Qualified Institutional Placement and Private Placement," the company said.
Revenue was largely driven by volumes. Hero MotoCorp dispatched a total of 18.68 lakh motorcycles and scooters, registering a 10 per cent growth year-on-year. The scooter segment recorded a 47 per cent growth to 2.40 lakh units in the September quarter of FY27.

sources.title: JSW Energy Q2FY27 results: Net profit grows over 38% to ₹1,141 crore
sources.description:
JSW Energy on Wednesday reported an over 38 per cent year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 1,141 crore in the September quarter, driven by higher revenues.
The company had posted a net profit of Rs 824 crore in the second quarter of the preceding financial year, JSW Energy said in an exchange filing.
During July-September, the company's total income rose to Rs 6,657.71 crore from Rs 5,361 crore in the year-ago period.
The board of JSW Energy also approved raising of long-term funds up to Rs 5,000 crore through the issuance of rated and listed non-convertible debentures on a private placement basis, in one or more tranches, and authorised the Finance Committee to decide on all matters relating to the issuance of the debentures, from time to time, including finalisation and approval of the detailed terms of issue, the filing said.

sources.title: Hyundai Motor India Q2 profit falls 23.9% as raw material costs rise
sources.description: Hyundai Motor India's Q2FY27 net profit fell 23.9 per cent to Rs 1,196 crore as rising raw material costs and higher employee expenses offset an 18.5 per cent increase in revenue.

sources.description: TVS Motor reported a 46 per cent rise in Q2FY27 consolidated net profit to Rs 1,219 crore, driven by record quarterly sales, strong export growth and a surge in electric two-wheeler volumes

sources.title: Adani Ports Q2 profit rises 18% to ₹3,682 crore, raises FY27 guidance
sources.description: Adani Ports reported an 18 per cent rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 3,682 crore and 24 per cent revenue growth, prompting it to raise its FY27 revenue, Ebitda and capex guidance.

sources.title: Adani Enterprises Q2 profit drops 55% even as operating earnings surge 62%
sources.description: Adani Enterprises' Q2 net profit fell 55% to ₹1,492 crore due to a high year-ago base, while total income surged 74% to ₹38,023 crore and EBITDA rose 62% to ₹6,316 crore.

sources.title: Vedanta Q2 net profit jumps 151% to ₹6,202 crore, revenue rises 57%
sources.description: Vedanta reported a 151 per cent jump in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 6,202 crore, while revenue rose 57 per cent to Rs 25,812 crore and Ebitda reached a record Rs 9,938 crore during the quarter.
